# anthropic_environment (Resource)

Environment resource. An environment is a cloud container template referenced by Managed Agents sessions. Environments are immutable: any change to `name` or `config` forces resource replacement. On `terraform destroy`, the API hard-delete is attempted first; if sessions still reference the environment, the resource is archived instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Unrestricted networking — sessions can reach any public host.
resource "anthropic_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
  config = {
    networking = {
      type = "unrestricted"
    }
  }
}

# Locked-down environment with explicit allow-list and pre-installed packages.
resource "anthropic_environment" "data_analysis" {
  name = "data-analysis"
  config = {
    networking = {
      type                   = "limited"
      allowed_hosts          = ["api.example.com"]
      allow_package_managers = true
    }
    packages = {
      pip = ["pandas", "numpy", "scikit-learn"]
      npm = ["express"]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) Container configuration. Immutable after creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String) Name of the Environment. Must be unique within the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Environment was archived, or null if not archived.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Environment was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the Environment.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Environment was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `networking` (Attributes) Outbound network access policy for the container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--networking))

Optional:

- `packages` (Attributes) Packages to pre-install in the container, indexed by package manager. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--packages))
- `type` (String) Environment kind. Currently always `cloud`.

<a id="nestedatt--config--networking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.networking`

Required:

- `type` (String) Networking mode: `unrestricted` or `limited`.

Optional:

- `allow_mcp_servers` (Boolean) When true, permits outbound access to MCP server endpoints configured on the agent. Only meaningful when `type = "limited"`. Defaults to false.
- `allow_package_managers` (Boolean) When true, permits outbound access to public package registries. Only meaningful when `type = "limited"`. Defaults to false.
- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) HTTPS-prefixed hosts the container may reach. Only valid when `type = "limited"`. Removing the attribute or setting it to `[]` will tighten/clear the list on update — kept Optional (not Computed) on purpose so security-tightening changes take effect.


<a id="nestedatt--config--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.packages`

Optional:

- `apt` (List of String) System packages installed via apt.
- `cargo` (List of String) Rust crates installed via cargo.
- `gem` (List of String) Ruby gems.
- `go` (List of String) Go modules.
- `npm` (List of String) Node.js packages.
- `pip` (List of String) Python packages.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing environment
terraform import anthropic_environment.example environment_id

# Example
terraform import anthropic_environment.example env_01HqR2k7vXbZ9mNpL3wYcT8f
```
